name: appshotr-mcp
stderr:
Usage: appshotr [options] [command]

appshotr · drives your logged-in ChatGPT in a real Chrome: attach an image,
prompt, save the generated image

Options:
  -V, --version                output the version number
  -h, --help                   display help for command

Commands:
  setup [options]              one-time: register the MCP in every agent on this
                               machine, link this machine to your appshotr plan,
                               sign in to ChatGPT
  install [options]            register the MCP server in the agents on this
                               machine · Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI,
                               Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code (setup
                               does this too)
  login [options]              open ChatGPT in the dedicated Chrome and wait
                               until you're signed in
  doctor [options]             check Chrome, the profile and the ChatGPT session
  gen [options] <prompt>       generate one image: fresh chat, attach input(s),
                               prompt, save the result
  batch [options] <file>       run a JSON file of jobs: [{ prompt, images?,
                               name?, out_dir? }, …] · one fresh chat per entry
  ask [options] <prompt>       send a text prompt to your ChatGPT and print the
                               reply
  collect [options] [chatUrl]  download the images of the last reply of a chat
                               (rescue after a timeout)
  plan                         the app's .appshotr/ memory: what was generated,
                               and the delivery folders built from it
  export [options] <files...>  convert images to App Store Connect spec (exact
                               size, RGB, no alpha) · no browser involved
  icon [options] <files...>    convert images to App Store icon spec: 1024x1024,
                               RGB, no alpha, full bleed
  link [options]               link this machine to your appshotr account (opens
                               a code you approve in the browser)
  unlink                       forget the appshotr token stored on this machine
  diag [options] [prompt]      walk a generation up to the send button and
                               measure it (why a click produces no turn). Sends
                               nothing by default.
  mcp                          the MCP server Claude Code talks to
  kill                         close any Chrome left holding the appshotr
                               profile (after a killed MCP server or Ctrl-C)
  update [options]             update to the latest appshotr-mcp: closes the
                               appshotr servers and Chrome that hold its files,
                               runs `npm i -g appshotr-mcp`, tells you how to
                               reconnect
  where                        print the data paths
  help [command]               display help for command
